rows.meaning: having a specified kind of heart
rows.note: Use this for being hard-hearted or unsympathetic, as in “a hard-hearted woman”.

example.english: That woman is really hard-hearted; she ignores the child even when he cries.
example.traditional: 嗰個女人真係心腸硬，見到個細路喊都唔理。
example.jyutping: go3 go3 neoi5 jan4 zan1 hai6 sam1 coeng4 ngaang6 gin3 dou2 go3 sai3 lou6 haam3 dou1 m4 lei5

rows.meaning: having a specified kind of heart
rows.note: Use this for being kind-hearted or well-meaning; it is the everyday positive description.

example.english: They are kind-hearted and offered to watch my luggage.
example.traditional: 佢好心幫我睇住啲行李。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 sam1 bong1 ngo5 tai2 zyu6 di1 haang4 lei5
